headerSets.name: RateLimit-*
headerSets.note: This set of headers is the standardization draft adopted by the IETF.

headers.name: RateLimit-Limit
headers.description: The total requests allowed for a 1-second window

headers.name: RateLimit-Remaining
headers.description: The number of requests left for a 1-second window

headers.name: RateLimit-Reset
headers.description: The delay in seconds before the rate limit is reset

headers.name: X-RateLimit-Limit
headers.description: The total requests allowed for a 1 second window

headers.name: X-RateLimit-Remaining
headers.description: The number of requests left for a 1 second window

headers.name: X-RateLimit-Reset
headers.description: The Unix timestamp when the rate limit will be reset

headerSets.name: Retry-After
headerSets.note: The header `Retry-After` is also available and indicate the delay in seconds before the rate limit is reset. It's equivalent to the `RateLimit-Reset` header.

headers.name: Retry-After
headers.description: The delay in seconds before the rate limit is reset

note: The response headers give you 2 different sets of rate limit headers `RateLimit-*` and `X-RateLimit-*`. You should choose one set of headers that match your needs.
